prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Sign-in reordering to post-adoption (+13.3%) or post-certificate (+5.8%), account recovery copy (+4.2%), and multi-device sync banners (+2.7%) worked; post-waiting sign-in hurt (-3.9%), while other sync hints had no clear effect.
Path selection clarity headlines (+5.9%), spotlight layouts (+2.7%), and visual redesigns (+5.9%) worked; checklist layouts hurt (-2.1%), while copy simplifications, value refreshes, time banners, and showcase layouts showed no clear effect.
Interactive waiting rooms (+5.6%), readiness/visibility status checks (+3.3%, +4.7%), and spawn location hints (+4.5%) worked; 3D progress trackers, completion timers, sound notifications, and spawn alerts showed no clear effect.
Companion previews paired with quality guides (+7.6%) or split upload layouts (+8.1%) worked; compact grids (-7.7%), photo fallback flows (-11.8%), quality guidelines banners (-5.0%), and mascot stamp redesigns (-24.1%) hurt results.
Interactive spawn placement flows (+6.2%) and system tray location tips (+3.8%) worked; direct controls guides (-14.4%) and first interaction tips (-6.5%) hurt results, while mascot greeting stages and docking hints showed no clear effect.
Predictions underpredicted major wins (spawn placement flows, visual redesigns, headline updates) and overpredicted outcomes on severe failures (mascot stamp redesigns, direct controls guides).

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Pet Sync Notice: Add an explicit account synchronization notice on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that existing pets and progress will be recovered upon signing in. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again; explicit copy reassures users before they log in.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Background Render Activity Display: Add an active desktop initialization banner and progress indicator to the waiting screen informing users that generation happens actively in the desktop environment. (why: Waiting stage mean time is 2336s and 3 users reported pets not showing or apps failing to open; explicit background activity info sets expectations.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Spotlight Path Selection Screen Redesign: Redesign the choose_path screen layout to spotlight mode to emphasize the contrast between choosing a starter companion vs creating a custom pet. (why: Choose path mean duration is high (514s), and past spotlight layouts improved conversion (+2.7%) by visual focus.)
3: [choose_path, new_screen] Pre-Selection Path Overview Screen: Insert a new introductory screen before path selection that introduces the two adoption paths with visual choice cards. (why: Path selection has an 85.3% conversion rate with long mean dwell times (514s); pre-orienting users reduces decision hesitation.)
4: [adoption, new_flow] Companion Pre-Adoption Review Flow: Add a companion confirmation screen right after picking a friend to let users verify their selected companion traits before proceeding to photos/certificate. (why: Adoption stage is the biggest bottleneck (68.9% conversion); confirming choices boosts intent and completion confidence.)
5: [finish, hint] System Tray Desktop Companion Retrieval Callout: Add a prominent tray recovery tip to home_intro explaining how to reopen or locate the desktop pet if minimized. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not showing on desktop or apps failing to open upon onboarding completion.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Story Welcome Headline Clarity Refresh: Update headline and body on story screen to emphasize fast setup and seamless background companionship. (why: Clear value headline updates on choose_path previously improved conversion by +5.9%.)
7: [home, notification] Background Completion System Notification Prompt: Enable system notification alerts on the waiting screen to notify users automatically when desktop pet preparation completes. (why: Waiting step mean duration is high (2336s); desktop notifications let users multitask while waiting.)

scores.note: Reassuring account sync copy aligns with past sign-in wins (+4.2%) and addresses 8 support emails, though sign-in drop is low.
Background status display helps reduce high wait-time drops (2336s mean), matching readiness check historical gains (+3.3%).
Spotlight layouts and redesigns on choose_path previously delivered strong results (+2.7% to +5.9%).
Adding pre-selection screens increases friction and cost, with new screens historically performing poorly.
Adoption step drops 31.1%, but adding review flows has strongly negative historical returns (-11.8%).
System tray recovery tips worked well previously (+3.8%) and directly address reported desktop companion retrieval support tickets.
Headline clarity updates on choose_path are zero-cost and previously yielded solid conversion gains (+5.9%).
System notification alerts have shown minimal effect (+0.2%) across prior experiments.
